question: Convert decimal number 26.85 into binary equivalent.
solution:
The correct answer is __11010.110110__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The decimal number 26.85 can be converted to binary by separately converting its integer and fractional parts to binary.
 
• The integer part (26) is converted to binary as 11010.
 
• The fractional part (0.85) is converted to binary as 110110 using multiplication by 2.
 
• Combining both parts, the binary equivalent of 26.85 is 11010.110110__.
 
• This binary representation is precise up to six fractional bits.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Binary Number System:**
 
 
• A binary number system uses only two digits: 0 and 1, also known as base-2.
 
• It is widely used in digital electronics and computer systems.
 
 
 
• **Decimal to Binary Conversion:**
 
 
• For the integer part, divide by 2 and write down the remainders in reverse.
 
• For the fractional part, multiply by 2 and record the integer parts until the desired precision is achieved.
